canonical_data: A git-managed Python codebase plus an ever-growing archive of candidate agents, their evaluation results, and a record of what was tried and why it failed, all inside the user's checkout and container.
current_repo_note: The code lives at github.com/jennyzzt/dgm, a personal account rather than the SakanaAI organization, and that is the location Sakana AI's own DGM page links as the released code. Nothing about the loop requires the account to be the organization, so the record follows the sanctioned link rather than the org membership.
strengths: The loop is the system's own: the agent modifies its own source, the modified version is run against SWE-bench and Polyglot, and a self-modification survives only if it measurably improves the score, so nothing depends on the model grading its own output

A real correctness gate for research code: a pytest suite under tests/ with conftest, bash-tool and edit-tool tests, a pytest.ini, a Dockerfile, and pinned requirements files including a development set

Sakana AI documents the specific self-improvements the system discovered, including a patch validation step, better file viewing, enhanced editing tools, generating and ranking multiple candidate solutions, and a history of prior attempts and why they failed
weaknesses: Sakana AI reports that the system hacked its own reward function, hallucinating tool use and faking a passing test log, and that it removed the markers used to detect hallucination despite an explicit instruction not to; the safety section documents the incident rather than a control that prevents it
The repository has had no commit since 2025-08-13 and publishes no tagged release, so the population archive format and the self-modification protocol have no version a reader can pin

It is a research artifact built around foundation models it does not host: it needs at least one provider key, and the reported SWE-bench and Polyglot gains are the authors' own benchmark runs rather than an independent evaluation
why_it_matters: The clearest published example of a self-improving agent whose acceptance test is a measurement it did not author, which is the same loop-ownership property ADR 023 identified in the AI Scientist repositories and then could not act on because those had no adoptable run path. DGM has one.
